snippet.title: Lighthouse of Madness | Steam, Playstation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
#QUByteConnect2025

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1564060/Lighthouse_of_Madness/

 Embark on this Lovecraft-inspired tale and discover the mysteries that await you in this island. Explore the enigmatic lighthouse, solve challenging puzzles and most importantly: try not to lose your sanity when facing the darkness of your mind.
